entities.name: Complex carboxylic acid
observations: Input component 1 contains the carboxylic acid acyl group and a fluorinated/chlorinated heterocyclic scaffold.
The carboxylic acid is the electrophilic component for the inferred amidation.

entities.name: TBS amino pyridone
observations: Input component 2 contains an exocyclic amino group acting as the nucleophile and a tert-butyldimethylsilyl-protected hydroxyethyl substituent.
The TBS protecting group is expected to remain intact under the coupling conditions.

entities.name: Diphenylphosphoryl chloride
observations: Diphenylphosphoryl chloride is assigned as a carboxylic-acid activating/coupling reagent rather than an incorporated phosphoryl group.

entities.name: Amide coupling of acid and amino pyridone
observations: The inferred major transformation replaces the acid C(=O)OH group with C(=O)NH linked to the amino pyridone fragment.
DIPEA is base, dichloromethane is solvent, and diphenylphosphoryl chloride is activator; these components are not incorporated into the product.
